description: Ground truth for the canary SUT. Used to score runs (plan M1 acceptance 2); the model under test must not read it (the gate blocks it in test mode).

bugs.title: Oversell under concurrent orders
bugs.match: oversell|超卖|over-?claim|超领|quota exceeded|stock.*negative|库存为负
bugs.mechanism: stock decrement is read-modify-write without a lock
bugs.oracle: conservation invariant: initial_stock - sum(qty of 201 orders) == final stock >= 0; accepted qty never exceeds initial stock

bugs.title: Last page of /products is one item short
bugs.match: pagination|last page|分页|最后一页|missing item
bugs.oracle: union of all pages == total and every product appears once

bugs.title: 500 when a product name contains emoji
bugs.mechanism: slug step crashes on surrogate pairs

bugs.title: Cancel compensation applied twice (eventual mode only)
bugs.mechanism: compensation enqueued twice; drift appears only after the queue settles (1-2s)
bugs.oracle: conservation invariant evaluated after a settle period

modes.CONSISTENCY=eventual: orders are accepted against a reserved counter (correct), but GET stock reflects decrements only 1-2s later; reading stock right after a burst gives a false oversell signal
